english.note: Use 隊長 as the all-purpose term for the leader or captain of an organized team, unit, or work group.

examples.english: Ming is captain for this match, and he will speak to the referee at crucial moments.
examples.traditional: 今場比賽由阿明做隊長，關鍵時刻佢會同裁判交涉。
